mod.name: Echoes of the Twilight Valley
npc.igor.name: Igor
npc.igor.background: A wanderer who once played in a post-punk band. He walks from town to town with a record crate, collecting things that lost their shine.
item.tea_of_silence.desc: A hot brew steeped in black rose petals. Grants inner balance.
item.black_rose.desc: A flower that drank moonlight and silence.
item.black_rose_seeds.desc: Grows slowly. The flower absorbs moonlight and silence.
item.vinyl_record.desc: An old record with a crackling sound. A decoration that remembers the past.
item.weeping_willow.desc: It whispers philosophy to those who listen.
item.weeping_willow_item.desc: Plant it, and the valley will have one more listener.
item.turntable.desc: Plays the Gloomy Wave on rainy days.
item.turntable_item.desc: Needs rain or fog to start.
buff.melancholy.desc: Bright melancholy fills you. You see the world sharper and feel nature's rhythm.
location.time-slowed: Time slows down here... Listen to the rain.
music.gloomy-wave-start: The needle finds the groove. Gloomy Wave begins.
music.wait-for-rain: The turntable is silent. It only plays when the sky frowns.
quote.willow.1: We look for light, but find only reflections.
quote.willow.3: Rain washes everything away... except memory.
quote.willow.4: Every echo returns changed. That is honest.
quote.willow.5: Nostalgia is gratitude with a minus sign.
quote.willow.6: The tram is late. Like everything real.
quote.willow.7: What was broken on purpose cannot be fixed by accident.
quote.willow.8: Evening arrives quietly. Like an old friend.
quote.willow.9: Rain doesn't ask permission. And it's right.
quote.willow.10: We remember not days, but the lines written in them.
quote.willow.11: The wind touches the branches — and that is enough to be heard.
quote.willow.12: Light always leaves a shadow. Don't apologize for it.
quote.willow.13: The homestead stood here before you. It will stand after. But tonight it is glad to see you.
quote.willow.14: Sadness is the price we pay for having loved.
quote.willow.15: Don't rush. The tram will arrive empty or full — but on time.
quote.willow.16: The echo doesn't return at once. Give it a road.
quote.willow.easter: ...Hear that? The last tram left without us. Never mind. The next one is ours.
config.timeslowdown.name: Twilight Time Slowdown
config.timeslowdown.desc: Atmospheric messages about time flowing on the homestead in rain and fog.
config.willow.name: Willow Whispers
config.willow.desc: The weeping whisper shares philosophical quotes on interaction.
config.interval.name: Message interval
config.interval.desc: How often (in game minutes) the homestead reminds you that time has slowed.
location.welcome: The Twilight Valley accepts you. Here you don't have to prove anything.
achievement.rainy-tea: Tea in the rain: cups drunk — {Count}. Inner peace grows stronger.
achievement.turntable.first: Needle on the groove. The first record plays — 'Wind up the turntable' goal complete.
config.aura.name: Melancholy aura
config.aura.desc: A placed Vinyl Record "Echo" quietly reminds of itself in rain and fog, granting the Serenity buff.
book.wanderer_notes.name: Wanderer's Notes
book.wanderer_notes.desc: A notebook in a worn cover. The pages smell of rain and cigarette smoke.
book.wanderer_notes.author: Igor?
book.wanderer_notes.p1:
The valley remembers everyone who left in the rain.
I am no exception. I just came back sooner.
book.wanderer_notes.p2:
The band played at the farmstead every Saturday.
The last chord broke mid-song.
Nobody noticed. Except me.
book.wanderer_notes.p3:
Black rose tea is brewed in silence.
Stir it with a spoon and the taste is gone.
Memory works the same way: don't touch it often.
book.wanderer_notes.p4:
An echo is not a sound.
It is the place where the sound hasn't come back yet.
Wait. It will return.
achievement.fog-rose: A rose planted in the fog. It will grow slowly — like everything real.
npc.timur.name: Timur
npc.timur.background: The former drummer of that band. Since the last chord broke, people say he speaks only in rhythm.
